evidence.sapActualBehavior: After clicking Order with valid PO data (Supplier 17300002, Material RMPI001, Qty 10, Price 0.08, Plant 1710), SAP displays a transient role=alert 'Purchase order has been created.' that does NOT include the 10-digit PO number. The page immediately navigates to the Manage Purchase Orders list. The PO IS created (verifiable via list search), but the success notification omits the PO number.
evidence.acText: A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission.
evidence.tcExpectedResult: A dedicated success confirmation notification is displayed immediately after clicking Order, containing the generated PO number (e.g., 'Purchase Order 4500065XXX created successfully').

defectMetadata.acText: A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission.

duplicateCheck.note: CS-6 was logged on 2026-05-18 for the same AC-6 violation by the same TC-CS-021. This re-run confirms the same behavior. No new Jira Bug created.

notes: SAP consistently shows generic alert without PO number across all runs. AC-6 violation confirmed. Existing Jira Bug CS-6 covers this defect — no new Bug created.
